song.title: You Don't Know How It Feels

guitar.notes: Original entry already well-balanced; keeping as-is — Petty/Campbell's gear genuinely spans multiple iconic instruments without one being singularly dominant.

tone.target: dry jangly Tom Petty clean with slight edge
tone.profile: dry jangly Tom Petty clean with slight edge
tone.summary: A classic Fender-style chain using light compression, a clean US Deluxe amp model, and minimal Room reverb to achieve the jangly, dry Tom Petty sound.

rig.name: Tom Petty - You Don't Know How It Feels - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.

Add subtle grit and edge without sounding dirty.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its clean, slightly broken-up character, mimicking a light overdrive pedal suitable for the genre.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more aggressive alternative if more grit is needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, chimey sound of a Fender-style amplifier.

Enhance the chime and brightness while keeping the low end tight.

blocks.gap: The V-Wah or C-Wah could be used if a specific filter sweep was required, but the tone calls for minimal filtering.
